title: Aromatic Airy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: This traditional Algerian dish is a sour and fluffy meal prep recipe featuring garlic cloves, lamb, and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The raw friendly ingredients make it a great option for those looking for a healthy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped dried apricots, preserved lemons, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the tagine or Dutch oven and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
